versions.changelog: Beta notice. Dependency declarations. Privacy/trust docs.
Removed development iteration artifacts. Cleaned domain-specific examples.

Initial release: Deep, time-bound online research skill with enforced best practices.

- Researches topics deeply for a set duration (e.g., 10 min, 2 hours, all night), reading and following leads like a human researcher.
- Uses a strict pre-flight checklist before starting (topic, duration, tools, autonomy, scheduling, output, clarifying questions)—must post plan and get explicit user approval before beginning.
- Enforces read-to-search ratio and full time commitment; prevents shallow or incomplete research.
- Supports autonomous and interactive research modes, with robust handling of loops/iterations and self-auditing before results are delivered.
- Works with web_search, web_fetch, and browser-use tools for broad and deep online research coverage.
- Designed to never finish early or skip checklist steps; prioritizes quality, transparency, and thoroughness.
